description: This Java class provides utility methods for URI encoding and decoding based on RFC 3986 and MIME 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' formats. It includes methods for encoding and decoding URI paths, path segments, query strings, and query parameters, with specific handling for reserved characters and certain application-specific quirks.

classes.name: UriEncoding
classes.description: A utility class for URI encoding and decoding that handles various URI components with support for RFC 3986 and form URL encoding.

methods.name: encodePath
methods.description: Encodes a URI path according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodePathSegment
methods.description: Encodes a URI path segment according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a query string based on the specified encoding type (RFC 3986 or form URL encoding).

methods.name: encodeQueryParam
methods.description: Encodes an individual query parameter based on the specified encoding type.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an encoded URI component according to the specified encoding type.
